subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline (Zenwell)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline (Zenwell)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier today. As promised, attached my initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a Redwood MAP template for reference. This is an operational draft to help align milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can get to a pilot quickly.

High-level MAP (v1) — key milestones and owners:
- Discovery closed (completed) — Owner: Zenwell (Samir) — Completed
- MAP sign-off — Owner: Zenwell (Executive sponsor) & Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2026-10-15
- Pilot environment provisioned (dev/test) — Owner: Redwood (Aditya) — Target: 2026-10-22 — Dependency: infra access / VPC peering
- Security/compliance review (SSO, data handling) — Owner: Zenwell (Priya) and Redwood (Aditya) — Target: 2026-10-29 — Dependency: SOC2 artifacts, network setup
- Contract & procurement signoff — Owner: Zenwell Legal / Procurement & Redwood Legal (Laura) — Target: 2026-11-05
- Pilot execution & evaluation — Owner: Zenwell Product & Redwood CS (Laura) — Target: 2026-11-19
- Production rollout / go-live — Owner: Joint — Target: 2026-12-03

Dependencies / notes:
- SSO / SAML configuration (Zenwell IT) — needed prior to production testing
- Data retention/audit log requirements to be confirmed during security review
- Estimated pilot resources: 1 dedicated GPU pool (small), 2 weeks of Redwood SE time for onboarding

Next steps / asks:
1) Please review the attached MAP draft (Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) and the template.
2) Confirm the stakeholders who should be on the MAP (I’ve tentatively listed Samir, Priya, Rajesh (CTO) and Procurement). If a different legal/procurement contact should own the contract milestone, please name them.
3) Pick which timeline you prefer: Option A (Aggressive — 6 weeks to pilot, target close 2026-11-12) or Option B (Conservative — 10 weeks to pilot, target close 2026-12-03).
4) Suggest any missing milestones or dependencies (e.g., SOC2 evidence, SSO vendor contacts).

I’m happy to run a 30-min MAP kickoff to finalize owners and dates if that helps — propose Tuesday/Wednesday next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx, redwood-map-template.pdf

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline (Zenwell)

Thanks Marissa — good summary and appreciated the clear owner calls. A few quick items from our side: 

- Timeline: can we push the overall close about two weeks later? Legal procurement at Zenwell is tight in Oct. Prefer target close late Nov / early Dec.
- Security: please add SSO/SAML integration as an explicit dependency and move the security review earlier (we need to unblock pilot testing).
- Contracts: want to add a discrete "Legal review" milestone so our legal team has a clear 5-business-day window after we submit redlines. Who should I loop from Redwood legal?
- Procurement: I'll confirm our procurement contact (likely Anita Shah) and loop her in once we have the MAP v2.

I’ll review the attached MAP and send comments inline this afternoon. Happy to meet for a quick 30-min MAP walkthrough next Tue (10/6) afternoon — works for me.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Product, Zenwell Health
samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0099

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline (Zenwell)

Samir — thanks for the quick feedback. I made updates inline and attached MAP v2 (Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx). Summary of changes based on your notes: 

- Moved security/compliance review earlier (now scheduled 2026-10-20) and split SSO/SAML as an explicit dependency with an action item for Zenwell IT to provide SSO metadata by 2026-10-12.
- Added "Legal review" milestone with a 5-business-day review window after submission; Redwood legal lead is Laura Bennett (cc'd).
- Adjusted target close to Option B (Conservative): Production target 2026-12-03 — this aligns with your procurement constraints.
- Noted procurement contact placeholder: Anita Shah (please confirm email).

Two timeline options included in the MAP v2:
- Option A (Aggressive): Pilot by 2026-10-22, Production 2026-11-12 — requires immediate SSO/infra access and accelerated legal review.
- Option B (Conservative): Pilot by 2026-11-19, Production 2026-12-03 — recommended if procurement/legal have standard timelines.

Suggested next steps:
1) Zenwell confirms stakeholders and procurement/legal contact (Anita?).
2) Zenwell IT shares SSO metadata and any firewall/egress rules by 2026-10-12 (or we start with sample data if timeline constrained).
3) Schedule a 30-min MAP walkthrough — I can block Tue 10/6 2:30pm PT or Wed 10/7 10:00am PT. Which works for you?

Thanks — attaching v2 for review.

Best,
Marissa
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx

From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline (Zenwell)

Thanks Marissa — v2 looks good. We prefer Option B (Conservative) to give legal/procurement time. Confirmed stakeholders for Zenwell: 
- Samir Gupta (Product)
- Priya Menon (IT & Security)
- Rajesh Varma (CTO) — rvarma@zenwellhealth.com
- Anita Shah (Procurement) — anita.shah@zenwellhealth.com

I’ll share SSO metadata with Aditya by 2026-10-12 and will loop Legal (Anita) once you send the contract draft. Tue 10/6 2:30pm PT works for a MAP walkthrough.

—Priya
